title: Envelope
description:
Every ordinary structured result. `T` is the per-primitive `data` payload; errors
use [`ErrorData`]. Field order is the spec example's order.

data.description: Per-primitive payload; never contains private keys or reusable secrets.

next.description: Machine next action, or `null` when nothing is expected of the caller.

operation_id.description: Present for effectful or long-running work; absent for pure reads.

schema_version.description: Major schema version of this document.

state.description: Operation state; synchronous reads report `succeeded` or `failed`.

Code.description:
The stable code table. Spec §11.6 lists the codes marked `spec`; the others are
baseline additions recorded in ADR-0006 §5 (primitives-draft Q3 is folded in).

oneOf.description: Synchronous read or control action completed.
`ensure`/`bind` produced usable access (spec §11.3 example). (spec)

Asynchronous request accepted; the payload reports a pending state
(spec §11.6 "asynchronous accepted/pending").
Additional owner authority is required; operation is `awaiting_approval`. (spec)

A provider or terminal interaction is required that non-interactive mode
refuses to open (spec §11.3). (spec)
The provider will not sign while locked (spec §7.1). (spec)
The minimum requested capability cannot be met (spec §4.3). (spec)
The standing policy is paused (spec §6.1). (spec)
A policy cutoff is in effect; fresh identifiers do not bypass it (spec §6.1). (spec)

The applicable grant or credential has expired; renewal cannot extend it
(spec §6.1). (spec)

Destination host identity changed; recovery must not accept it silently
(spec §9.1). (spec)

A delegation request is broader or longer than its parent (spec §6.7;
primitives-draft Q3).
The operation was explicitly cancelled (spec §11.4).
Destination not reachable over any approved route. (spec)
Safe time cannot be established; issuance stopped (spec §6.4). (spec)
The SSH client or consumer is unsupported for the requested path (spec §10.3). (spec)
The per-user runtime cannot be reached or started (spec §13.1).

The local state store is unavailable, locked, corrupt, or newer than this
build; unsafe operations stop and recovery is offered (spec §13.3, §15.2).
A bounded queue or buffer is full; retry with backoff or resync (spec §11.5).
Same idempotency key with different canonical parameters (spec §11.4). (spec)
Managed configuration conflicts with a newer user edit (spec §10.1). (spec)

The idempotency record for this key has aged out; the retry is not silently
treated as new (spec §11.4).

The event cursor is expired or foreign; take a snapshot and resume from its
cursor boundary (spec §11.2, §11.5; primitives-draft Q3).
An external mutation may or may not have applied (spec §7.5, §11.4). (spec)
Invalid arguments or request body.

Unsupported schema major, protocol version, or required capability
(spec §11.2).

The referenced operation, binding, grant, profile, or environment is unknown
to this runtime (possibly purged by retention).
Unexpected internal failure; never used to hide a classified condition.

ConsumerIntegration.description: How a consumer reaches the binding (no secrets).

environment.description: Environment variables a launcher should set (names and values; never secrets).

signing_endpoint.description: Signing endpoint path or pipe name, if one is materialized.

ssh_config_include.description: Generated OpenSSH include path, if one is materialized.

Cursor.description: Opaque, reader-scoped resumption token. Never parse it outside the runtime.

DestinationScopeEnforcement.description: Destination-scope enforcement levels (spec §4.3), ordered weakest to strongest.

oneOf.description: Not known.
Intent only; nothing enforces it.
Client configuration routes to the destination.
Agent restriction authenticated to the destination (spec S03).
Server-side principal mapping verified by test.
A separately tested isolated execution boundary.

Enforcement.description:
Structured guarantee report (spec §4.3, §11.3 `enforcement`). Every claim
references evidence held by the runtime; `Unknown` is a valid value.

new_authentication_expiry.description: What stops new authentication at expiry.

consumer.description:
Consumer integration descriptor; contains endpoints and config references,
never secrets.

environment_id.description: Environment the binding is pinned to.

offline_until.description: Usable with no controller/issuer contact until.

ExistingConnectionsPolicy.description: Effect on existing connections at expiry (spec §6.6).

oneOf.description: Not known.
Dedicated connections may stay; owned masters are closed.
Owned connections are closed at expiry.

NewAuthenticationExpiry.description: What ends new authentication at expiry (spec §4.3 "Expiry").

oneOf.description: Not known.
Only the local signer stops.
Certificate validity and the signer both stop.
Nothing stops new authentication (existing fixed credentials).

NextAction.description:
Machine next action (spec §11.2 `next`, §11.6 "machine-readable next action").
`action` names are stable; parameters are present only when relevant.

action.description: Stable action name; defaults come from [`Code::default_next_action`].

cursor.description: Cursor to resume from after a resync.

decision_ref.description: Nonsecret reference to a pending owner decision.

retry_after_ms.description: Suggested minimum delay before a retry.

OperationState.description: Operation states (spec §11.4). A caller timeout is not a state change.

oneOf.description: Accepted and journaled; not yet running.
In progress.
Waiting for an owner or provider decision on an owner channel.
Terminal: completed with a result.
Terminal: failed with a classified error.

Terminal: explicitly cancelled; the result says whether an irreversible or
uncertain step may have occurred.
Terminal until reconciled: an external effect may or may not have applied.
No refresh needed before `expires_at`.
Needs the local issuer.
Needs the controller device.
Needs provider interaction.
Not known.
Applied locally.
Acknowledged remotely.
Remote effect pending.
Bounded only by an already-issued credential's expiry.

SchemaVersion.description: A `schema_version` value as received from a peer.

Warning.description: A non-fatal finding attached to a result.

message.description: Human text; may change without breaking callers.

oneOf.description: Not known.
Shared OS-user environment; same-user convenience only.
Separately authenticated service boundary.
A specifically tested isolated workload.
